answer: Bind each bond to a hardware root key. Sign every submission with that key and a monotonic counter. Split custody across three auditors so release needs two signatures. Replay is the detector: a duplicated counter on another account fails verification regardless of its name. Measured on a trellis of 200 accounts, replay caught 11 duplicates the name check missed. The signal is the counter, not the label, and one orchard of clones costs 200 root keys.
